strongest_bounded_proposition: Slavery is directly documented in Jaffna under Dutch and early British rule around 1800; abolition measures developed only afterward.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not generalize Jaffna evidence to all British Ceylon or treat British acquisition as immediate emancipation.
territorial_practice_summary: Slavery and legally constituted slave statuses documented in Jaffna.
legal_state_summary: British rule inherited locally codified slavery; abolition measures began from 1806.
temporal_scope_precision: Study spans late eighteenth/early nineteenth century.
inference_extent: Subregional claim only; island-wide prevalence unassessed.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible packet only; non-English/non-digitized scholarship not exhaustively searched.

sources.title: The Ambivalence of Freedom: Slaves in Jaffna
sources.author: Nira Wickramasinghe and Alicia Schrikker
